sermon.title: The Power of God’s People Pt 4 — January 12, 2025
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Jonathan and his armor bearer climbed up and God caused trembling in the Philistine camp; the hidden came out to fight. Saul’s rash oath troubled the people, as man’s laws do today. God’s people have power and influence—who do you say Christ is?
